entities.name: Hunyadi & Matthias Corvinus
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: John Hunyadi's defence against Ottoman expansion, the victory at Belgrade (1456). Matthias Corvinus (r. 1458–1490) created a Renaissance court, the Bibliotheca Corviniana, and briefly controlled Vienna and Bohemia.
